title: Impact of Virtual Reality on Rehabilitation of Distal Radial Fracture with head mounted device
protocol: Obtain informed consent and medical history from subjects.
Allocate subjects to Experimental Group or Control Group.
Experimental group undergoes 6 weeks of intervention: Leap motion control rehabilitation for 30 min/day and conventional rehabilitation for 30 min/day.
Control group undergoes 6 weeks of intervention: Conventional rehabilitation for 60 min/day.
